title: Vincen’s Is A MUST See!
text: Seeing Casa Vincen’s is a must. I suggest going here first before seeing any of Gaudi’s other works. Be sure not to miss the video of the restoration process at the end of the tour near the gift shop. I feel it should be placed in a more prominent location in the house as you truly can appreciate the work and artistry involved to recreate what we are fortunate to be able to see today. Last thing, we never buy things in museum gift shops. We did this time! Definitely take a moment to peruse the items in the gift shop.
author: Jana_A

title: Favorite place in Barcelona
text:
Visiting Casa Vicens was a unique and indescribable experience. 
The house is one of my favorite places in Barcelona, for which I would visit this beautiful city again and again.
Through the use of the audio guide, one was continuously shown how precise and well-thought-out every single detail of the house is.  The audio recording is precise and perfectly tailored to the location. I have not been able to listen to such an audio recording in this form in any other museum or similar, except at Casa Batlló.
The atmosphere inside the house and garden is unique and indescribable!
The staff members

title: Beautiful building, very vivid and well-maintained, with a lot of attention to detail.
text: I enjoyed it very much; beautiful, playful, imaginative, with a great deal of attention to detail. Gaudi was unique, the price is very high, but it is really worth it for anyone who likes this architecture. Very well-maintained grounds, nice for lingering and enjoying.
